entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: The white-blue god of the polis on Theros, embodying law, civilization, scholarship and civic order; a colossal Nyxborn being.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane whose pantheon includes Ephara.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: The enlightened polis where Ephara's cult is strongest and where the first code of law is preserved.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God of the sun, ideologically aligned with Ephara.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God of the sea, whom Ephara respects.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God whose forgework supports city infrastructure, mutually respected by Ephara.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God of the hunt and wilderness, in deep mutual resentment with Ephara.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: God of deception, Ephara's bitter rival.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: God of agriculture whose ties to Setessa and Nylea put her at odds with Ephara.

entities.name: Agnomakhos
entities.description: A cruel, oppressive tyrant who ruled Meletis until its people overthrew him with Ephara's magic.

entities.name: Cacophony
entities.description: A newly born god who began to claim dominion over cities, destroyed by Ephara.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: The god who enacted the Silence of the Gods.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: A cosmic event enacted by Kruphix in which the gods withdrew their direct presence from the world.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor in whose vision Ephara appears defending Theros.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion during which Ephara defended Theros.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The divine essence of Theros from which godfire is infused.

entities.name: godfire
entities.description: A Nyx-infused divine flame that burns without fuel and symbolizes divine resistance.

events.summary: Ephara bestows magic on the people of Meletis, letting them overthrow the tyrant Archon Agnomakhos.
events.quote: Ephara once bestowed magic upon the people of Meletis

events.summary: Ephara destroys the newborn god Cacophony as a threat to social harmony.
During the Silence of the Gods enacted by Kruphix, Ephara withdraws her direct presence from the world.
events.quote: Ephara — like her fellow deities — withdrew her direct presence from the world.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Ephara appears in Elesh Norn's vision defending Theros and blesses its champions with godfire.
events.quote: She blessed the champions of Theros with divine flame

relations.note: Ideologically aligned; both value law, structure and justice.
relations.quote: She is ideologically aligned with Heliod

relations.note: Mutual respect from appreciation of craftsmanship.

relations.quote: Her relationship with Karametra is more complicated.
Ephara was responsible for the destruction of Cacophony
